crops.name: Rice
crops.tips: Maintain standing water during early growth and use certified seeds.

crops.name: Wheat
crops.tips: Irrigate at crown root initiation, flowering, and grain filling stages.

crops.name: Cotton
crops.tips: Use integrated pest management and avoid waterlogging.

crops.name: Maize
crops.tips: Keep the field weed-free for the first 45 days.

crops.name: Groundnut
crops.tips: Use gypsum at flowering stage for better pod development.

crops.name: Tomato
crops.tips: Use staking, mulching, and regular scouting for leaf diseases.

pests.management: Use disease-free seedlings, remove infected plants, control whiteflies with neem oil, and avoid excessive nitrogen.
Use pheromone traps, remove stubbles, apply recommended bio-control agents, and avoid excess nitrogen.
Install pheromone traps, grow trap crops, use Bt cotton where suitable, and follow local advisory before spraying.
Use resistant varieties, monitor humidity, remove infected residues, and contact agriculture officers for fungicide advice.

schemes.name: PM-KISAN
schemes.benefit: Income support to eligible farmer families.
schemes.eligibility: Small and marginal farmers as per government norms.
schemes.action: Check registration status through the official PM-KISAN portal or local agriculture office.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
schemes.benefit: Crop insurance support against natural calamities and crop loss.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers growing notified crops in notified areas.
schemes.action: Apply through banks, CSC centers, or the official crop insurance portal.

schemes.name: Soil Health Card Scheme
schemes.benefit: Soil nutrient report and fertilizer recommendations.
schemes.eligibility: All farmers can request soil testing through agriculture departments.
schemes.action: Submit soil samples at the nearest soil testing center.

schemes.name: PM Krishi Sinchai Yojana
schemes.benefit: Support for efficient irrigation and water conservation.
schemes.action: Contact local agriculture or irrigation department for subsidy details.

sustainable_tips: Use drip irrigation or sprinkler irrigation to reduce water waste.
Apply compost, green manure, and crop residue recycling to improve soil health.
Follow crop rotation to break pest cycles and maintain nutrients.
Use neem-based pest control before chemical sprays where suitable.
Mulch the soil to reduce evaporation and weed growth.
Test soil before fertilizer application to prevent overuse.
